## Changes

- Replace plain validation output with structured local errors, warnings and information, including explanations, filters and actions that open the relevant setting, catalog entry or folder.
- Check saved settings before startup and identify configuration files changed outside the manager. Checks run without modifying files and can be cancelled.
- Add backup history with dates, per-file actions, byte sizes and side-by-side redacted previews. Read complete older backups as well as new backups with hash manifests.
- Restore a stopped local server after reviewing and confirming the file changes. Create a safety backup first, reload the editor after success and leave the server stopped. Restore configurations by default, with a separate opt-in for listed content files.
- Reject stale comparisons, damaged or incomplete copies, unsupported paths and running servers. Stage replacements and roll back ordinary write failures where safe.
- Use direct loopback HTTP requests for local connection checks, independent of HTTP proxy settings.
- Add isolated core and WPF checks for diagnostics, recovery, cancellation, privacy and running-server guards.

## Download

Extract the entire `ACServerManager-0.7.0-preview-win-x64.zip` archive and run `AssettoServerManager.exe`. Windows x64; .NET is included. Select your servers and Assetto Corsa folders on first launch. Game content, Content Manager and AssettoServer are installed separately.

## Preview limits

Diagnostics are local and do not verify internet reachability, every mod/plugin combination or successful client loading. Restore supports complete local manager backups, preserves unrelated files and is not power-loss atomic. Review warnings and keep important backups separately. Presets and server cloning remain planned for later versions.
